blocks.text: Clean feels good when you clean with Clorox Disinfecting Cleaning Wipes, now with new sparkling scents. Perfect for spring cleaning and allergy season, these Clorox Disinfecting Cleaning Wipes help reduce allergens while delivering powerful disinfection. This convenient multi-surface wipes variety pack includes Fresh Scent and Crisp Lemon, ideal for tackling seasonal deep cleaning tasks throughout your home. Safe to use on over 100 surfaces, including finished wood, sealed granite, glass and stainless steel make kitchen and bathroom cleaning easy, these antibacterial wipes kill 99.9% of germs and are perfect for quick cleanups. Great for allergy season cleaning, they help remove dust and allergens from surfaces while leaving them fresh and clean. Our bleach-free formula is safe on multiple surfaces and leaves no harsh chemical residue. Ideal for spring cleaning tasks, these sanitizing wipes are perfect for households needing convenient, no-rinse cleaning solutions.
